summary: The Plane of Innovation is the divine realm of mechanized creation, where gears, pistons, and endless machinery embody divine progress. Mortals who enter face trials of invention and mechanized horrors.
history: Formed when divine forces claimed dominion over invention and mechanization.
Clockwork Maze became the labyrinth of gears and pistons.
Scrapforge reforges broken constructs into new horrors.
Mechanized Core pulses with divine mechanical energy.
